title: Turkish characters corrupted in ACE message flow output to downstream system
description: ACE integration flow that processes customer data from an SAP system is corrupting Turkish characters (such as s, i, g, o, u with cedilla/breve) in the output. The characters are being replaced with question marks or Latin equivalents. The input from SAP contains correct Turkish characters.

worklogs.description: Traced the encoding through the flow. SAP input comes in as ISO-8859-9 (Turkish). The HTTP connector sends output as UTF-8 but applies string conversion without explicit encoding specification.
Added an ESQL compute node before the HTTP output that explicitly converts the encoding from ISO-8859-9 to UTF-8.
Tested with sample Turkish customer names including all diacritic characters. All characters preserved correctly in output.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Customer names with Turkish special characters are showing as garbled in our CRM after the ACE integration runs. For example 'Mustafa Kucukcaglayan' loses the cedilla and breve characters.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, this is a character encoding conversion issue. The SAP system sends data in ISO-8859-9 (the Turkish character encoding) but the ACE flow converts it to UTF-8 without explicitly mapping the Turkish characters. I can fix this by adding an explicit encoding conversion step. I will test this fix with a set of Turkish names that use all the affected characters before deploying.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Fix tested and deployed. Could you run a test with a customer record that has Turkish characters and check the output in the CRM?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Tested with Yusuf Caglaroglu - the name now appears correctly in the CRM with the breve and cedilla intact. Thank you.

resolutionNote: SAP source data is encoded in ISO-8859-9 (Turkish character set). The ACE HTTP output connector was applying a generic charset conversion without preserving Turkish-specific characters. Added an explicit ESQL encoding conversion step (1254 to UTF-8) before the output connector.
